title: Log Session End
summary: A Claude Code hook that appends a timestamped line with the working folder and session id to a local log file each time a turn ends.
description: A plain log answers questions like when you last worked on a project and which session to resume. This Stop hook adds one line to session-log.txt inside your .claude folder at the end of every turn.
Each line holds an ISO timestamp, the working directory and the session id. The file stays on your machine, is never sent anywhere and can be deleted at any time.
useWhen: Keep a record of when you used the agent
Find the session id to resume later
Track which folders you worked in today
Estimate how long a task took

example.result: After the turn, ~/.claude/session-log.txt gains a line such as '2026-11-15T09:42:10.000Z  /home/ana/shop  8f3c-2b1a'.

faq.question: Where is the file kept?
faq.answer: In the .claude folder of your home directory, created on first use.

faq.question: Does a line mean the whole session ended?
faq.answer: No. Stop fires after every finished turn, so a long session adds many lines with the same session id.

access: Appends a line to session-log.txt in your home .claude folder
Reads the clock and the event data only
